findings:
X-RAY CHEST AP VIEW


Clinical profile: Known case of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis with acute exacerbation.

There are diffuse interstitial shadows/ reticulations noted in the bilateral lungs with haziness in the bilateral CP angles and silhouetting of the left hemidiaphragm - can suggest severe basal predominant disease or pleural effusions.

There is mediastinal shift to the right - suggestive of asymmetric loss of lung volume.
